faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Shetland Sheepdog?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 15-25 lb (7-11 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Shetland Sheepdog?

faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Shetland Sheepdog, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
